purpose: Observe the selected vehicle's lock, Sentry, door/window and auxiliary security state alongside workspace-bounded security-event samples and derived changes.
primaryGoal: Determine what is actually known about vehicle security, inspect individual windows and live signals, and review recorded security history without confusing unknown or retained evidence with a current measurement.

dataSources.name: Vehicle registry
dataSources.sourceOwnership: Vehicle API registry; the page piggybacks the existing vehicles query to expose fleet-list failures, not to render a second picker.
dataSources.behavior: Preserve vehicleKeys.all, STALE_TIMES.FAST, safeArray and AbortSignal forwarding.

dataSources.name: Latest security state
dataSources.sourceOwnership: SecurityHandler.Latest projects the current signal.LiveStateReader result; missing signals are omitted. It does not return created_at or an observation-age envelope.
dataSources.behavior: Enabled only with a selected vehicle, keyed by vehicle, polls every 5000ms, forwards AbortSignal and is independent of the history date range. Page derives live DataState and passes only fatal errors into panel replacements.

dataSources.name: Security history
dataSources.sourceOwnership: SecurityHandler.List reads StateReader.Timeline using the parsed range and forward-folded signal projections, aliases ts to created_at and assigns response-local numeric IDs.
dataSources.behavior: Enabled only with a vehicle; both bounds enter the query key and request. safeArray guards the selected feed. The page additionally excludes missing/invalid timestamps and enforces start <= timestamp < end. The server implementation does not paginate here; underlying Timeline completeness, ordering and exact end-bound behavior remain unverified.

dataSources.name: Workspace scope
dataSources.owner: Existing workspace header and selection hooks
dataSources.sourceOwnership: The page consumes persisted vehicle scope and shared range instants without a competing local picker.
dataSources.behavior: Keep workspace vehicle and rolling/custom range ownership, URL state and timezone semantics. Selection-hook internals were not inspected.

dataSources.name: Presentation-derived security evidence
dataSources.sourceOwnership: Existing page/feature calculations derive sample percentages, last lock observation, daily sample buckets, sample counts, twin props and semantic transition rows; no new backend analytics are implied.
dataSources.behavior: Sentry uptime is percentage of returned event samples, not time-weighted uptime. Daily buckets use the timestamp's first ten characters, not a proved workspace-local calendar. Preserve raw feeds and existing calculations pending a separately owned correctness change.

components.name: PageLayout / PageContainer
components.use: Existing full-width container adapter forwards query and dataSources into canonical header freshness and per-source notices. Do not replace with a second page shell.

components.name: SecurityOperationalBrief / SecurityStatisticsBrief -> OperationalBrief
components.use: Four summary metrics and seven history statistics use the current operational metric pipeline, localized scope/provenance, retained/source-status labels and specialist formatters.

components.name: GlassPanel, PanelTitle, Text, Caption, Badge, Button
components.use: Already adopted through category barrels. Feature StatusTile owns repeated tile presentation rather than six separate bespoke renderers.

components.name: SecurityStatusCards, LiveVehicleState, WindowStatusDetail, StatusTile
components.use: Six posture tiles, ten live-signal tiles and four individual windows; retain all three complementary representations.

components.name: DigitalTwinPanel -> VehicleTwin -> Tooltip
components.use: Interactive means informational tooltip hotspots, not lock/door vehicle commands. Uses selected-vehicle paint resolution, measured-width sizing, photo-to-SVG fallback and shared motion preference.

components.name: SentryModeChart -> EmbeddedChart
components.use: Shared category imports, persistent chartKey, localized title and data columns; stacked on/off sample counts, tooltip, legend and hidden-series handling. Canonical frame internals were not inspected.

components.name: EventHistoryTable -> DataTable
components.use: Time/lock/Sentry/doors/windows columns, initial source ordering, Time sorting, value filters, compact local pagination, stable persistence ID and shared loaded-row export/search/density behavior.

components.name: EventTimeline / TimeStamp / feedback / FadeIn
components.kind: domain list / shared display and feedback
components.use: Semantic list, localized change labels, timestamp renderer, bounded internal scrolling, retries and empty states. Existing motion and feedback owners must remain.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: StatusTile already consolidates the posture, auxiliary-live and window grids. Similar-looking data is not duplicate functionality: aggregate windows, each window and physical twin convey different detail.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Reuse this domain owner and existing primitive tokens; do not create a new global status-card system or delete complementary sections.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: The same latest-query retry/error/loading policy appears in four panels; history policy appears in chart, statistics, table and timeline. These are independently visible panels, not evidence for a new competing query-state engine.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Keep independent panel boundaries while adapting the existing DataState contract; consolidate only genuinely identical feature-level presentation if needed.

responsive.sourceStrategy: Five named sections remain mounted; posture/live/analytics stack until xl, then use 1:2 or 2:1 columns; table/timeline split only at 2xl. Internal posture grid is 1/sm:2/3xl:3, live grid 2/sm:3/2xl:4 and individual windows remain 2 columns. Twin uses ResizeObserver and max-w-full, so a nominal 300px size alone is not proof of overflow.

issues.rule: MDC-023 / MDC-043 no mobile detail loss
issues.detail: mobileColumns exposes only time, lock and Sentry. DataTable applies hidden md:table-cell to doors/windows; this caller supplies neither expandable details nor mobilePresentation. Historical per-row door/window values have no source-confirmed mobile detail surface.
issues.fix: Use the existing DataTable mobile/detail contract to retain all five fields, or retain all columns with deliberate contained scrolling. Preserve filters, export scope, row order, tableId and pagination.

issues.detail: Tile label, value and description all truncate without an explicit full-detail affordance. Two-column windows/live layouts can clip longer translated names and states. Timeline titles/subtitles also truncate beside a nonshrinking timestamp.
issues.fix: Allow sensible wrapping and min-w-0 composition or use the existing accessible detail/help mechanism; retain full source values at narrow allocated widths and 200% text.

positiveSourceEvidence: Decorative status/timeline icons hidden in aria-hidden wrappers
Shared table, feedback, Button and TimeStamp owners are reused
Digital twin and posture initial-loading wrappers expose role=status and aria-busy

issues.rule: MDC-040 / MDC-044 keyboard and localized names
issues.detail: InteractiveHotspot supplies Tooltip an empty nonfocusable span; inspected Tooltip clones aria-describedby, not tabIndex or a semantic control. Twin also has a fixed English generic role=img label and hardcoded security tooltip labels. The page's duplicated text tiles do not prove equivalent keyboard access to every twin hotspot.
issues.fix: Have the existing VehicleTwin owner provide localized state-aware accessible names and focusable informational hotspots or an equivalent complete accessible description, reusing Tooltip rather than introducing another interaction engine. Do not turn tooltip inspection into vehicle commands.

acceptanceStillRequired: Screen-reader state description and table interaction
Real composed AA contrast in light/dark/custom themes

states.loading: Latest twin/posture show localized initial-loading skeletons; live/windows and history panels have skeletons/frame loading. Summary metrics use source-specific loading suppression. Sections are not globally removed for missing data.
states.empty: Twin, posture and live panels have no-data messages; windows keep four Unknown tiles. Chart, table, timeline and statistics retain explicit empty surfaces. Empty history shows zero total/sample uptime in the summary while the detailed statistics are missing; these meanings must not be silently merged.
states.error: Page derives fatalError separately for latest/history and forwards independent retries; vehicle-registry failures participate in PageContainer's existing source notices. No new global fatal gating is added.
states.staleOffline: deriveDataState retains usable payload on refresh failure/paused fetch. Both briefs expose retained evidence and PageContainer receives per-source query notices. The Live chip currently does not consume this trust state.
states.disabled: Latest and history queries are disabled without activeId. No local selector or security mutation button is rendered.

issues.rule: MDC-025 / MDC-026 unknown is not a measured negative
issues.detail: A null/absent locked field renders danger/Unlocked although its filter label preserves unknown. Sentry missing becomes Off; posture missing Sentry/HomeLink/guest become Inactive/Away/Disabled. doorClosed(null) returns true while unknown windows count as open/venting. Missing projected fields can therefore imply a measured secure/insecure state.
issues.fix: Use domain tri-state classification and existing neutral status primitives, consistently across summary, posture, history and derivations. Retain raw data and separately review changes to existing aggregate semantics; never silently fill unknowns with false/zero.

issues.rule: MDC-026 / MDC-046 source freshness is not renderability
issues.detail: The pulsing Live chip renders whenever latest is truthy, including retained failed/offline data and a successful empty object. The page supplies observedAt=latest.createdAt, but Latest returns only mapped fields and no created_at. Query-success time must not be presented as signal-observation time.
issues.fix: Pass the existing source trust state into this domain renderer and reuse canonical status/freshness presentation. Distinguish retained, blocked, partial and unknown; keep observation age unknown unless the existing backend contract supplies it. Any real freshness envelope belongs to an integration owner.

visualIssues.rule: MDC-010 / MDC-012 / MDC-015 restrained semantic color
visualIssues.detail: Local six-hue neon chip mapping, fixed 300-level value text, white-translucent tile surface/border and hover decoration compete with shared semantic tokens. Timeline has a parallel neon mapping and white row surface. This is source evidence of inconsistent theme ownership, not a measured contrast failure.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing surface/border/text/severity tokens; keep semantic distinction and icon/text meaning, reduce decorative hue and remove hover treatment from noninteractive cards. Do not reset user theme/chart preferences or delete status information.

visualIssues.detail: Shared twin includes glow filters and looping semantic lighting/Sentry effects. Shared reduced-motion helpers are present, but their source presence does not prove runtime motion compliance; not all visual glow is necessary security information.
visualIssues.fix: Ask the existing VehicleTwin owner to subdue decorative glow/ambient emphasis while retaining meaningful hazards, turn signals, Sentry, lights and all physical-state cues. Reuse existing motion preferences; do not fork the renderer in this page.

architectureIssues.detail: SecurityEvent requires string id and createdAt even for Latest, which emits neither. List emits numeric response-local IDs. Door/window response values can have runtime shapes wider than these declarations; helper paths already accept unknown. This undermines observation metadata and stable-row assumptions.
architectureIssues.fix: Integration owner should reconcile actual latest/history payload types, optional identity/timestamps and raw signal value shapes without introducing fabricated metadata or changing wire/cache values. Preserve existing scoped query keys and raw feeds.

architectureIssues.detail: findLastLockChange and lockEvents assume incoming ordering, while deriveTimeline explicitly sorts newest-first. Daily buckets slice source dates and uptime is sample-weighted. The handler inspection establishes no ordering or local-calendar guarantee for the underlying Timeline reader.
architectureIssues.fix: Keep the current explanations, sample semantics, full original inputs and fallback timestamp behavior during presentation work. Assign ordering/calendar correctness verification to integration rather than silently changing calculations or calling sample counts complete/time-weighted history.

priority.rationale: Security-critical unknown-state labels, retained-data Live presentation and hidden historical mobile detail need attention before cosmetic adoption. Existing shared layouts/briefs/chart/table owners already provide a strong baseline; no page replacement is justified.
sequence: Integration: source types, tri-state interpretation and trust metadata
Page: full mobile detail and nontruncating localized content
Shared owner: twin localization, accessible hotspots and restrained semantic animation

requiredSharedChanges.name: VehicleTwin accessible informational state presentation
requiredSharedChanges.concretePropsVariantsStates: Extend the existing interactive informational surface, not vehicle-command behavior: localized state-aware role=img description, focusable described informational hotspots or equivalent complete text, explicit unknown states; preserve size, measured-width behavior, selected vehicleId paint resolution, photo fallback and reduce preference.
dependsOn: Canonical localization and shared motion preference
requiredSharedChanges.scopeLimit: Only this production consumer was inspected; no evidence-backed need for a new shared composite is claimed. Coordinate with the existing owner.

requiredSharedChanges.name: VehicleTwin restrained semantic rendering
requiredSharedChanges.concretePropsVariantsStates: Adjust the existing renderer's decorative glow/ambient treatment without a new palette, state registry or page-local twin variant; preserve active/inactive/unknown physical cues, photo/SVG fallback, motion preferences and informative tooltip content.
dependsOn: Existing shared semantic color and motion owners
Runtime review separating meaningful flashing from decorative loops
requiredSharedChanges.scopeLimit: Shared owner analysis only; no shared source edits authorized.

competingImplementations.detail: Two local chip maps overlap the canonical token/severity ownership. Consolidate appearance without inventing a universal status meaning registry.

competingImplementations.pattern: Legacy versus mounted security metric presentation
competingImplementations.decision: reuse OperationalBrief; do not restore old stat grids
competingImplementations.detail: The barrel still exports SummaryStatsRow and SecurityStatistics, but this mounted page explicitly uses SecurityOperationalBrief and SecurityStatisticsBrief. Export presence is not mounted coverage; older implementations were not semantically reviewed and must not replace the current metric owner.

competingImplementations.pattern: Workspace vehicle/date controls, layouts, chart and table
competingImplementations.detail: No competing local picker, layout engine, chart frame or table pipeline is needed. Mobile detail is an adoption gap, not proof that DataTable needs replacement.

preservation.presentationLineCountScope: Page plus the nine mounted domain renderers and StatusTile; excludes helpers, barrel, shared owners, tests and unmounted legacy metric components.
conditionalSections: Insecure-vehicle AlertBanner at page lines 147-158; retain its actual-data condition rather than making a warning unconditional.
actions: Shared workspace vehicle and View settings range selection; do not add a second local owner.
Independent refetchLatest retries in twin/posture/live/window fatal-error surfaces.
Independent refetchHistory retries in chart/statistics/table/timeline, explicit statistics refresh button and timeline/statistics empty-state recovery.
Informational digital-twin tooltip inspection; no lock/unlock/door commands are present.

Time-column sorting, loaded-row value filtering, canonical table controls, local pagination starting at 50, column/paging preferences and loaded matching-row CSV/JSON exports through DataTable defaults.
Sentry legend/hidden-series callback, tooltip and frame data-column alternatives with chartKey admin-security-sentry-mode.
Shared header freshness/source notices and existing page copy-link composition; inherited runtime actions were not exercised.
dataBehavior: Keep all three queries, vehicle enablement, 5000ms latest polling, cancellation and existing cache/retry policy.
Keep exact shared range bounds in history key/request and the frontend half-open timestamp guard.
Summary keeps status, last lock observation/fallback, sample Sentry percentage and total events.
Posture keeps lock, Sentry, doors, aggregate windows, HomeLink proximity and guest mode.

Live state keeps hazards, high beams, turn signal, driver-seat occupancy, paired keys, valet mode, service mode, speed-limit mode, HomeLink device count and center display; native bool/string states remain supported.
Window detail keeps front driver/passenger and rear driver/passenger positions including Unknown.
Twin adapter keeps door/window/frunk/trunk/lock/Sentry/lights/hazards/turn-signal/seat cues; keep selected-vehicle paint resolution and unknown unsupported cues.
Chart keeps source-date on/off sample buckets and shared palette/legend/data table contracts.
Statistics keep lock transitions, sample Sentry percentage, door/window-open sample counts, HomeLink, guest samples and total, with complete sample-not-time-weighted explanations.
Table keeps all five columns, raw source order until Time sorting and response row identities; do not replace scoped results with fixtures or export only the visible page.

Timeline keeps lock/Sentry/door semantic transitions, localized descriptions, newest-first sorting, existing approximate 50-event stop (one iteration may add several transitions), timestamps and scroll reachability.
Keep loading/empty/fatal-error/retry/retained/offline source behavior and independent neighboring panels.
Preserve raw wire/cache values and current specialist calculations; no SI conversion, authentication changes, backend invention or operational mutation is authorized by this inventory.
